newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA'S LAW FIRES ESSEX TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA'S LAW FIRES ESSEX TO VICTORY.

text.p: Australia's Stuart Law hammered 123 to carry Essex to an eight-wicket victory over Sussex in an English Sunday League 40-over match at Hove.
Law, who raced past the century-mark in just 76 balls, put on an opening partnership of 199 runs with Paul Prichard (68) as Essex eased past Sussex's 216 for six, with almost 10 overs to spare.
Fast bowler Ashley Cowan, named in the England squad on Sunday for the second test against Australia starting on Thursday, celebrated with three for 33 for Essex.
England captain Mike Atherton warmed up for the Lord's test with an unbeaten 90 in Lancashire's 17-run victory over Kent at Old Trafford.
Lancashire made 172 for three from a reduced 35 overs and then skittled Kent out for 155, with Glen Chapple taking three for 22.
Atherton's England team mate Graham Thorpe continued his fine run of form, striking an unbeaten 100 to guide Surrey to a five-wicket win against Yorkshire at The Oval.
Glamorgan gained some revenge for their dismal batting performance in a county championship match the previous day, overcoming Middlesex by six wickets in Cardiff.
The Welsh side crashed to 31 all out to lose by over an innings to Middlesex on Saturday but thanks to an unbeaten 71 by Matthew Maynard cruised to their victory target of 186 in 35.3 overs.
Warwickshire made a remarkable 201 for six from their rain-reduced 21 overs to beat Derbyshire by 108 runs at Edgbaston.
Neil Smith hammered a quickfire 60 and Dougie Brown a 19-ball half-century.
Worcestershire fell just one run short of victory against Gloucestershire (177 all out) at Bristol after Stuart Lampitt, needing a boundary off the last ball, could manage only two.
